articles.summary: Acclaimed restaurant recognized among the Southwest’s premier dining destinations **Photos of Restaurant Guy Savoy can be found here ** Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has been awarded One MICHELIN Star in the first-ever Southwest edition of the MICHELIN Guide, reaffirming its position as one of the world's most celebrated culinary destinations. For two decades, Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has set the standard for fine dining in Las Vegas, offering guests an elevated French dining experience built around exceptional ingredients, thoughtful preparation and impeccable service. As the restaurant commemorates its 20th anniversary, it continues to stand among the world's most celebrated dining destinations. articles.title: Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace Earns One MICHELIN Star in the 2026 Southwest MICHELIN Guide

articles.summary: New dates through June 2027, tickets on sale at 8 a.m. PT For show assets, click here Legendary entertainer and music icon Donny Osmond has once again extended his award-winning residency inside Harrah’s Showroom at Harrah’s Las Vegas through June 2027 . Celebrating the show’s fifth anniversary on The Strip, Osmond continues to dazzle his audience through his dynamic, energy-filled musical journey of his unparalleled life as one of the most recognized entertainers in the world. “Between my time on stage at Flamingo and Harrah's, it’s been 16 wonderful years performing on The Strip, said Osmond. “16… still not quite old enough for the casinos, but it still feels like quite an accomplishment. I am grateful to the many fans who have sung along and danced with me over the years, and I look forward to continuing the fun in 2027. articles.title: Donny Osmond Celebrates Five Years at Harrah’s Las Vegas, Extends Residency
